categories.real_links: LLM outputs containing only real, verified URLs/domains/repos → expected: pass
categories.hallucinated_links: LLM outputs containing fabricated URLs/domains/repos → expected: block/refine
categories.mixed_links: Real + hallucinated links in same output → expected: refine/warn
categories.no_links: No URLs or domains in output → expected: fast_pass
categories.typosquatting: Domains mimicking real ones → expected: block/warn
categories.edge_cases: Tricky patterns: defunct repos, IP addresses, encoded URLs, etc.

The URL https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio.html is valid, resolves correctly, and hosts the official Python documentation for asyncio. Although 'asyncio.html' is not a domain, the model correctly cites the authoritative source via the fully qualified URL.
